name: Hosty AI Gateway
description: Hosty assistant service: admin-only operator chat sessions supervised on a host-resident agent harness. Headless — Shell renders the chat UI and calls this API with delegated tokens.

settings.label: Transcript retention (days)
settings.description: Sessions and transcripts older than this are deleted by the daily cleanup sweep.

settings.label: Anthropic API key
settings.description: Credential for the Claude harness (the Agent SDK does not read an interactive `claude login` state). Alternative: set the Claude Code OAuth token instead.

settings.label: Claude Code OAuth token
settings.description: Token minted by `claude setup-token` — the subscription-based alternative to an API key.

catalogMetadata.summary: Admin-only Hosty assistant: operator chat sessions on a host-resident agent harness.
